newsitem.title: UK: News Corp may offer 30 pct of ASkyB - FT.
newsitem.headline: News Corp may offer 30 pct of ASkyB - FT.

text.p: News Corp Ltd is considering to float off 30 percent American Sky Broadcasting (AskyB), the one billion dollar satellite venture scheduled for launch next year, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
News Corp was not immediately available for comment.

The paper quoted Rupert Murdoch, News Corp's chairman, as saying he would probably go for a public offering after venture partner MCI Communications said last month it wanted to reduce its ASkyB stake.
Shortly after announcing its $20 billion merger with British Telecommunications Plc, MCI said it wanted to reduce its ASkyB holding to 20 percent from 50 percent.
"Their intention is to hold at least 20 percent and then we would probably have an IPO for 30 percent," the FT quoted Murdoch as saying.
Murdoch added ASkyB was aimed to be launched by mid-October.
ASkyB is hoping to form alliances with the U.S. regional telephone companies to market and service the satellite sytem and install receiving equipment, the FT said.
